claims.sentence: The university classifies information products into five age-based categories
For information products intended for children who have not reached the age of six, the sign consists of the digit «0» and the «plus» sign

For information products intended for children who have reached the age of six, the sign consists of the digit «6» and the «plus» sign and/or a text warning in the form of the phrase «for children over six years old»

For information products intended for children who have reached the age of twelve, the sign consists of the digit «12» and the «plus» sign and/or a text warning in the form of the phrase «for children over 12 years old»

For information products intended for children who have reached the age of sixteen, the sign consists of the digit «16» and the «plus» sign and/or a text warning in the form of the phrase «for children over 16 years old»
For information products prohibited for children, the sign consists of the digit «18» and the «plus» sign and/or a text warning in the form of the phrase «prohibited for children»

On the university’s corporate website and portal, pages may contain the information product sign (including in machine-readable form) and/or a text warning about restrictions on dissemination among children
These signs and warnings must correspond to one of the categories established by Federal Law No. 436
The classification of information products is carried out independently by structural units in accordance with the requirements of the Regulation

The corporate website and portal of the university are not allowed to post announcements inviting students to participate in the creation of information products that cause harm to their health and/or development
The evidence does not specify where on the website or portal the signs must be placed, only that they may be present
It does not define the visual design, size, or color of the signs beyond the digit and plus sign description
The evidence does not state how often the classification is reviewed or who in the structural units is responsible for it
The evidence does not provide details on the machine-readable format of the signs
The evidence does not specify what happens if a sign is missing or incorrect
The evidence does not address age restrictions for public-facing content outside the corporate website/portal
The evidence does not define "harm to health and/or development"
The evidence does not specify the exact text of Federal Law No. 436, only that the categories align with it
